title: Afternoon Delight
details: Vicki’s Chapter 2 job pays GTA$10,000 through BuckMe the following in-game day.
steps: Finish Coffee Break and advance the remaining story jobs until Vicki calls.
Meet her at Delights. Follow the story prompts through the performance and complete the mission with your partner.
Check BuckMe the next in-game day for Vicki’s payment.

title: Game Horde earbuds
details: Buy a pair for the character you want to use. Jason and Lucia have separate audio gear.
steps: Open the in-game map index and choose Style → Electronics to find Game Horde.
Purchase earbuds, equip them from the headgear slot, then hold D-pad Left on foot to choose a station.

title: First duffel bag
details: Lab Fees unlocks the duffel bag as story equipment. It equips when Jason picks up mission loot.
steps: After Gone Fishing, choose Collect Brian’s Rent on the Key Lento map and follow Jason’s marker to Moonstone Boutique.
Play through Lab Fees and complete the drop-off. Check Equipment in the Progress menu afterward.

title: Kingpin luxury watch
details: The Chapter 2 bowling alley job includes a collectible watch in the southeast office.
steps: Complete Coffee Break. Choose the optional Hit Kingpin Bowling marker.
Inside the southeast office, pick up the watch with the gold item icon. This is one of three valuables for the activity.

title: Let’s Go Bowling trophy
details: Completing all three valuable objectives in Kingpin Bowling can earn this achievement.
steps: After Coffee Break, open the optional Kingpin Bowling job.
Collect the three items identified by the activity checklist. Finish the exit objective and wait for the achievement notification.

title: Aimie dancer card
details: A NINE1NINE card is tucked away inside the Rusty Anchor bar.
steps: Visit The Rusty Anchor in northwest Key Lento.
Look inside the restroom stall marked Captain’s Log. Pick up Aimie to add her to the set.

title: Wonder Whale sculpture scan
details: The whale outside the Wonder Whale counts as a phone scan in the sculpture collection.
steps: Find the souvenir shop on Surfside Drive.
On foot, open the WAiNK app and scan the whale outside.

title: Off the Hook magazine
details: Chapter 1 offers a copy in the workshop below Jason’s house.
steps: Visit Jason’s house before finishing Chapter 1.
Go downstairs to the tool shed and read the magazine.

title: RX Men magazine
details: The Key Lento branch of 24/7 stocks this readable collectible.
steps: Enter the 24/7 supermarket.
Read RX Men at the magazine display.

title: Remote Strike magazine
details: Lucia gains access to this part of Ajax Gym during Chapter 4.
steps: Once Lucia can enter the gym’s trauma room, check the reading material there.
Read Remote Strike to register the volume.

title: High Rollerz, issue 37
details: Find the issue upstairs in the Jack of Hearts club.
steps: Go up to the club’s second floor.
Look in the hall west of the recording booths and read the magazine.

title: Vicki dancer card
details: An early Delights Dancers card is available inside the Starlet Motel during Chapter 2.
steps: Enter the motel office before Chapter 2 ends.
Check the floor of the office bathroom beside the toilet and pick up Vicki.

title: Harley dancer card
details: Delights has a second reason to visit after Vicki’s story job.
steps: Look for a booth against the club’s east wall.
Collect Harley from its seat. If the club is closed after Chapter 2, return once it reopens.

title: Marquise Bernard card
details: A Los Santos Panic card sits outside Kenton’s shop.
steps: Visit Kenton in Key Lento.
Check the barrel immediately outside the shop and collect the card.

title: Kenton’s treasure sets
details: Kenton adds treasure sites to your in-game map as you return completed sets.
steps: Finish Island Dreams, then wait for Kenton’s invitation and use the green KR marker.
At the marked shipwrecks use the diving tools to recover the set. Bring it to Kenton and check for his next call.

title: Mount Kalaga summit meditation
details: The final meditation unlocks when the other meditations are complete.
steps: Wait for the new purple marker to appear on the in-game map.
Use the stone circle at the summit. Check your meditation total under Collections.

title: Help Me Help You Help Me
details: This copy is on a reception table in the Starlet Motel during Chapter 2.
steps: Visit reception before the end of Chapter 2.
Read the volume on the table to record it in your collection.

title: Stock 305 streetwear
details: Ultimate Edition includes access to the Stock 305 clothing selection.
steps: In the map index, choose Style → Casual & Street.
Visit Stock 305 and browse the character’s outfits. The bonus requires the Ultimate Edition.

title: Macca the Gator merchandise
details: Ultimate Edition players can browse Macca apparel at the Wonder Whale.
steps: Select the Key Lento souvenir shop using the Style index.
Browse the shop mannequins for the themed clothing and accessories.

title: Paradise Garage and Dominator buggy
details: A Chapter 2 Ultimate Edition reward includes the garage in Watson Bay.
steps: Visit the Mud Club with Wyman during Chapter 2.
Look under Exploration for the task associated with the buggy and garage.

title: Ambrosia Raceway gold
details: The trial lists 15 seconds as its gold target.
steps: Approach Ambrosia Raceway Park to reveal the race icon.
Start the Ambrosia Raceway Trial and check your medal in Activities → Racing.

title: Gellhorn Raceway gold
details: The circuit trial has a gold target of 3 minutes 15 seconds.
steps: Approach the circuit and complete Beau’s introductory lap when prompted.
Select the Raceway Trial. The Dragway Trial has a separate target.

title: Boone Speedway gold
details: The Boone Speedway Trial lists gold at 21 seconds.
steps: Visit the speedway in southwest Hamlet.
Choose the time trial and check the race screen for your best medal.

title: Yasmani’s vault introduction
details: The optional Chapter 4 job That’s Where the Money Is… unlocks further vault tips.
steps: Finish VCIA Takedown. Respond to Yasmani’s call and use the Wait at the Cafe mission marker.
Sit at the café window to start the mission. Complete the in-game objectives with your partner.
Check Yasmani’s newly available tips after finishing the story job.

title: Fleeca · Key Lento
details: A small bank job in Key Lento. The branch becomes available after Credit Check in Chapter 3.
steps: Select Bank Jobs in the game’s Robberies map filter.
Highlight the branch and finish both listed objectives. The icon changes to bright green when the game registers completion.

title: Pool · The Rusty Anchor
details: Challenge the pool opponent at The Rusty Anchor in Key Lento. A win against a distinct opponent counts toward the five needed for 100% completion.
steps: Enter the bar and find the table used during Chapter 1.
Challenge the opponent if present. If the table is unattended, revisit later.
evidenceNote: PowerPyx identifies the bar and story table. GTADB supplies the bar coordinate.

title: Pool · Delights Cabaret
details: Delights in Port Gellhorn has a pool opponent. If the club has closed after Chapter 2, return when it reopens later in the story.
steps: Enter Delights when it is open.
Look for the pool table near the middle of the club and challenge the opponent.
evidenceNote: PowerPyx identifies the club and pool table. The linked GTADB venue coordinate is marked unconfirmed by GTADB.

title: Pool · Jacob’s Tavern
details: The pool table is on the north side of Jacob’s Tavern in eastern Millport.
steps: Find Jacob’s Tavern near the Millport Pay ’n’ Spray.
Go to the north side of the tavern and challenge the pool opponent.
evidenceNote: PowerPyx identifies the tavern and table. GTADB supplies the tavern coordinate and spells the town Millport.

title: Golf · Leaf Links Golf Challenge
details: Play the regular golf challenge at Leaf Links. The 100% checklist's two-course requirement applies to mini golf.
steps: Head to the Leaf Links Golf Club grounds.
Find the Leaf Links Golf Challenge on the in-game map. Check your result under Activities → Sports in the Progress menu.
evidenceNote: PowerPyx places the challenge at Leaf Links. GTADB supplies the golf club location. Pin covers the club grounds.

title: Fitness · Ajax Gym
details: Ajax Gym in Vice Beach offers strength and cardio workouts with a one-time in-game membership.
steps: Find Ajax Gym on SW 4th St in Vice Beach.
Join the gym if needed and choose an exercise from the equipment prompts.
evidenceNote: PowerPyx lists Ajax Gym and GTADB supplies the named gym coordinate.

title: Fitness · Muscle Sands
details: Muscle Sands is a free workout venue at Ocean Beach in Vice Beach.
steps: Find Muscle Sands at Ocean Beach.
Use the workout equipment available at the venue.
evidenceNote: PowerPyx lists Muscle Sands as a free gym and GTADB supplies the named venue coordinate.

title: Fitness · Grand Majestic Gym
details: The Grand Majestic in Tequesta has a gym with a one-time in-game membership.
steps: Travel to the Grand Majestic in Tequesta.
Use the in-game Fitness → Gyms map filter to locate the gym at the property.
evidenceNote: PowerPyx lists the gym. GTADB supplies the Grand Majestic property coordinate, with entry-level precision unresolved.

title: Arcade · Jason’s home console
details: In Chapter 1, the home JoySystem plays Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind. Later home consoles are at different story locations.
steps: In Chapter 1, use the controller by the TV at Jason’s house in Key Lento.
Select one of the three available games. Each game launch can count toward the completion checklist.
evidenceNote: PowerPyx's video game guide identifies the home console library. Its Feng Shui walkthrough places the Chapter 1 console at Jason’s house in Key Lento. GTADB supplies the house coordinate.
